description: This is a build and test script for running rialto unit tests, including setup for coverage and valgrind analysis, with functions for building targets, running tests, and generating reports.

methods.name: runcmd
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command, exits if the command fails with an error code other than 0 or valgrind error code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, sets environment variables, optionally cleans build directory, builds targets, and runs tests.

methods.name: strOfKeys
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of suite info into a comma-separated string of keys.

methods.name: getSuitesToRun
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of suites to run based on user input, defaults to all suites.

methods.name: buildTargets
methods.description: Configures and builds test targets using cmake and make.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs the specified test suites with optional valgrind and coverage, handles test result processing.

methods.name: AddValgrind
methods.description: Constructs valgrind command arguments with options for output redirection and suppression files.

methods.name: generateCoverageReport
methods.description: Generates code coverage reports using lcov and genhtml, and writes statistics.
